chunks: You can see among them many allying themselves with the infidels. Vile it was what they sent ahead of them, so that God's indignation came upon them; and torment will they suffer an eternity.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that they sent ahead God's anger?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Ma'idah is often linked to the Banu Quraiza and the Hypocrites (Munafiqun) who formed political alliances with the Quraysh against the Prophet Muhammad. The phrase 'what their souls had sent forth' refers to their own deeds of allegiance, which precipitated divine wrath, emphasizing that their choice of allies determined their eternal fate in the Fire.
